note: v2 expands the fix list for walkable buried treads after the #341 six. Live audit source: stair_collision_341_report_audit_20261105_063452.json (L_World_Factions_A after the six #341 meshes are already complex-as-simple). The original six keep their Blender FBX scan numbers (x/y/z/buried_cm and hull). New fix entries use live-audit heights only (scan z values and live_audit_buried); no fake Blender hull numbers. Meshes whose simple collision (one UCX hull from the ground up) covers a tread the render mesh shows. Tools/fix_stair_collision_341.py switches the fix list to complex as simple; GFGame.Movement.StairKit.TownCollision asserts it. Towers, fences, trees, walls, pipes, wagons and props stay on simple collision (audit_only).
